question: On what specific day and for what ritual purposes was the goddess of gods approached in that very place?
premises: The action takes place in that very location.
The occasion is a single specific day.
The intended acts are worship and recitation directed to the goddess of gods.
inference: On that particular day in that very place, the purpose was to worship and recite to the goddess of gods.
uncertainties: The subject performing the worship and recitation is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, there on one day, it was to worship and indeed to recite to the goddess of gods.
